name: Legacy: Latency Percentiles

queries.name: main
queries.sql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(OccurredAt) AS bucket,
  quantile(0.5)(TotalDurationMs) AS p50,
  quantile(0.9)(TotalDurationMs) AS p90,
  quantile(0.99)(TotalDurationMs) AS p99
FROM trace_metrics
WHERE OccurredAt >= {period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {period_end:DateTime}
  AND TotalDurationMs > 0
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket
